6.310 rsReportItemInScopedAggregate
rsReportItemInScopedAggregate is a critical error that occurs when the following conditions are true:
An expression within a PageSection or PageHeaderFooter contains an aggregate function that has

its Scope parameter set.
That expression references a report item via the ReportItems global collection.

